# Brightmere

> Brightmere gives operationally complex businesses operational and financial clarity - run at a resolution a spreadsheet can't reach. We read the same business through three lenses: financial clarity (is the profit real, repeatable and cash-backed - unit economics, working capital, margin, cash), operational clarity (can the operation physically deliver the plan - capacity and the true bottleneck, read from the operational log), and leadership clarity (how much depends on the founder or a few key people, measured from what the systems reveal). Every finding is computed from a company's actual data, line by line, and sized in pounds. Owner-led or PE-backed, and on either side of a deal.

## What Brightmere does

- Financial clarity (the Cash X-Ray): a diagnostic connecting finance and ERP systems to trace cash and profit line by line, finding where money is trapped or leaking and sizing each gap in pounds
- Operational clarity (the operator lens): computing real capacity and the binding constraint from the operational log, to test whether a growth or deal plan is physically deliverable
- Leadership clarity (the dependency lens): reconstructing founder and key-person dependency from system exhaust - who the revenue is attached to, who actually decides, and what happens when they step back
- Ongoing: a live operating cadence and reporting that keeps the numbers clear, and trustworthy in front of a board, a lender, or a buyer
